parse.title: Troll Stronghold/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===Stronghold Dungeon=== {{Checklist|*Follow the red path to [[Troll General]]. Kill one and loot the [[Prison key (Troll Stronghold)|prison key]]. (Can be safespotted with a halberd, magic, or a ranged weapon behind the counter) '''(Hardcore Ironmen beware! The general is aggressive and his max hit is 38)''' *Follow the green path to jail. *Pickpocket (30+ {{SCP|Thieving}}) or kill the sleeping [[Twig]] and [[Berry]] (this can be safespotted through the open cell doors either side of them), free '''both''' of the prisoners. *Teleport to [[Burthorpe]] with the [[games necklace]] OR follow them out the secret exit and once outside climb over the south-east rocks. *Talk to [[Dunstan]]. *'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
